question: Is Malachi Tony truly the best player in college football this season?

stances.renee-vaughn: MODERATOR: I will frame the debate, source the claims, and press both sides without taking a side myself.
stances.dale-ruttman: Yes, Malachi Tony is truly the best player in college football this season because his overall impact, fundamentals, and football IQ set him apart beyond just position-specific skills.
stances.cassius-wynn: No, Malachi Tony is not the best player in college football this season; despite his versatility and accolades, the title belongs to Jeremiah Smith, the undisputed best wide receiver with superior position-specific skills and accuracy.

waypoints.note: Malachi's fundamentals and football IQ make him the best overall player, not just a receiver.
But Jeremiah Smith's elite accuracy and status as the best receiver challenge Malachi's claim to being the best overall.
Malachi's versatility and ability to impact the game in multiple ways outweighs pure receiver skills.
Yet Malachi is not better than Jeremiah Smith at wide receiver, which is the most critical skill for the title of best player.
The best player isn't just about one position; Malachi's all-around ability and leadership prove his superiority.
Recognition from experts and stats favor Jeremiah Smith as the top player, not Malachi.
